invites_role_known.name: invites_role_known
invites_role_known.value: "invites"."role_id" is not null or "invites"."role_name" is not null

retainer_entries_amount_sign.name: retainer_entries_amount_sign
retainer_entries_amount_sign.value: case "retainer_entries"."kind" when 'top_up' then "retainer_entries"."amount" > 0 when 'adjustment' then "retainer_entries"."amount" <> 0 else "retainer_entries"."amount" < 0 end

time_entries_start_end.name: time_entries_start_end
time_entries_start_end.value:
("time_entries"."start_minute" is null) = ("time_entries"."end_minute" is null)
        and "time_entries"."start_minute" between 0 and 1440 and "time_entries"."end_minute" between "time_entries"."start_minute" and 1440
